design_system.philosophy: Modern Scientific / Industrial Control Room. Function over form. Data is the primary visual. Zero decorative gradients. Extreme clarity.

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6
spacing_and_layout.surface_style: GRID BORDERS - flat backgrounds, 1px solid border (#E2E8F0), rounded-none or very subtle rounded-sm (max 4px). No soft drop shadows, use sharp structural hierarchy.

tabs.style: Minimalist underline style. Active tab gets a 2px solid black bottom border. No pills or bubbles.

inputs_sliders.style: Sharp corners, high contrast borders (border-slate-300 focus:border-black). Sliders should use stark black/blue tracks.
inputs_sliders.layout: Stack with clear mono-spaced value outputs next to labels.

charts.style: Clean white background. Hide outer axis lines. Use dashed light-gray lines for CartesianGrid. Use ReferenceLine for SP (Setpoint) and markers (tr, ts).
charts.features: Must include Tooltip, Legend, and zoom/pan functionality. Export to PNG.

buttons.style: Square (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary buttons are solid black with white text. Secondary are white with 1px black border.

icons.style: Regular or Light weight, matching the technical aesthetic.

image_urls.notes: No placeholder images required. The application relies entirely on data visualization and form controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize the React application and configure Tailwind CSS.
Install standard Shadcn UI components: tabs, slider, input, button, card, label.
Install 'recharts' for data visualization. This is critical for the Open/Closed loop step responses.
Install 'html2canvas' or similar to handle the Chart export to PNG functionality.
Structure the App with a top Header (Title: 'Controle Automático - C213', Group: 'Grupo 9') and a main Tabs component.
Tab 1 (Identificação): Interface to upload .mat file, plot the open-loop response, execute Smith Method, and display calculated parameters (K, τ, θ) and MSE in large monospace fonts.
Tab 2 (Controle PID): Interface with Sliders/Inputs for manual tuning (Kp, Ti, Td) and buttons for Auto-tuning (Ziegler-Nichols, ITAE).

Tab 3 (Gráficos): Large interactive charts comparing Open-Loop vs Closed-Loop. Include a Metrics Dashboard bento-box showing Rise Time (tr), Settling Time (ts), Overshoot (Mp), and Steady-State Error (ess).
Ensure every interactive element and data display has a 'data-testid' (e.g., 'data-testid="upload-dataset-button"', 'data-testid="kp-slider"').
Override any Shadcn default border-radius to `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none` to fit the technical Swiss archetype.
